Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
This just came up on JOL, and there is a dispute. And the various
answers we found by searching, while answering the question, aren't as
direct as the following:

Situation: I block my opponent. In combat, my opponent plays Form of
Mist at superior to end combat and continue the action at +1 stealth.
I declare an aggravated hand strike with Chiropteran Marauder. I then
play Rotschreck.

Does this immediately end combat and send my opponent to torpor?

Thanks,
-Peter
